topics.definition: Containerization packages an application and its dependencies into a portable container.
topics.example: Running a web app in Docker

topics.definition: Containers share the host OS kernel, while virtual machines include a full guest operating system.
tips: Containers are generally lighter and start faster.

topics.definition: Docker consists of the Docker Client, Docker Engine and Docker Registry.
tips: Learn how the client communicates with the daemon.

topics.definition: A Dockerfile contains instructions to build a Docker image.
A Docker image is a read-only template used to create containers.
tips: Use official base images when possible.

topics.definition: A container is a running instance of a Docker image.
tips: Stop unused containers to save resources.

topics.definition: Docker networking enables communication between containers and external systems.
Build small images, avoid running as root and keep images updated.
